description: This Java source file defines the class 'SudoStreamSnapshots', which implements a command for starting a stream of snapshots within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides methods for creating, parsing, and manipulating snapshots stream commands, including specifying batch size, timeout, lower bounds, and snapshot fields.
